d: India's proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) is being projected as critical to the country's hydropower needs and national security, particularly amid China's dam-building plans on the Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet. But in Arunachal Pradesh's Upper Siang district, the project has triggered fierce resistance. From Geku village to Yingkiong, residents fear losing their homes, ancestral land, livelihoods and cultural heritage. As protests intensify and the government pushes for preliminary surveys, The Indian Express' Premankur Biswas travel through the Siang valley to…
